units.source_text: 夕雾不知道别人正为了他而闹得天翻地覆，管自前来探望太君。

en.t: Yugiri had no idea that others were in an uproar over him, and simply came to visit the Lady.

units.source_text: 前夜他来此，为了人目众多，不能与云居雁密谈心事。

en.t: He had come here the night before, but because there were too many eyes upon them, he could not speak privately with Kumoi no Kari about what was in his heart.

units.source_text: 今天比往日相思更苦，便在晚上来了。

en.t: Today his longing was more painful than usual, so he came in the evening.

units.source_text: 太君往日看见外孙来了，总是欢天喜地，笑逐颜开，今天忽然板起面孔说话了。

en.t: In the past, whenever the Lady saw her grandson arrive, she was always overjoyed and all smiles, but today she suddenly spoke with a stern face.

units.source_text: 她对夕雾说：“为了你的事，你舅舅恨煞了我，我好为难啊！

en.t: She said to Yugiri, "Because of this matter of yours, your uncle hates me terribly, and I am in a very difficult position!

units.source_text: 你胡思乱想，教别人懊恼，真不应该！

en.t: It is truly wrong of you to indulge in foolish thoughts and make others suffer!

units.source_text: 我本来不想谈此种事情，不谈又怕你不明白。”

en.t: I did not want to speak of such things at all, but if I said nothing, I feared you would not understand."

units.source_text: 夕雾本来怀着鬼胎，立刻猜测到了，红着脸答道：“究竟为了何事？

en.t: Yugiri already had a guilty secret in his heart, so he guessed at once and answered with a flushed face, "What exactly is this about?

units.source_text: 我近来笼闭一室，静心读书，久无机会参与人群，并未得罪舅舅呢。”

en.t: Lately I have shut myself in one room and quietly devoted myself to study; I have had no chance to mingle with people for a long time, and I have not offended my uncle."
As he spoke, his face was full of embarrassment.

units.source_text: 太君很可怜他，说道：“不必谈了，总之你以后小心谨慎就是了。”

en.t: The Lady felt great pity for him and said, "There is no need to speak of it further; in any case, you need only be careful and prudent from now on."

units.source_text: 说到这里为止，以后便谈别的事情。

en.t: The matter ended there, and afterward they spoke of other things.
